description: ADR-009 D2, 15 §2.1–§2.3: the app-server handshake negotiates no capability field, and a probe that does not answer within PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS gives launch its fail-closed false; the session's capabilities are the Codex ceiling merged with the in-force X1 row and that probe (the merge never rises above the lower source). The first turn is written and never answered.
